query: 重要性（Materiality）评估 重要性（Materiality）评估 衡量企业识别并优先管理重大ESG议题的能力。 2分：采用了双重重要性原则（同时考虑财务影响与对环境/社会的影响）；详细披露了利益相关方参与的具体数据；议题与公司战略、KPI挂钩。 1分：披露了评估流程（如发放调查问卷），并提供了重要性矩阵 (Materiality Matrix)，但缺乏动态调整或双重重要性（Double Materiality）的思考。 0分：未披露重要性评估过程，或仅列出议题清单，未解释议题是如何选出的，无矩阵或排名。 重要性评估 实质性议题 重要性矩阵 双重重要性 利益相关方参与 议题排序 影响重要性 财务重要性 Double Materiality materiality assessment material topics materiality matrix double materiality stakeholder engagement issue prioritization impact materiality financial materiality Double Materiality 重要性评估流程如何开展？ 利益相关方如何参与及是否有具体数据？ 是否提供重要性矩阵或议题排名？ 是否采用双重重要性？ 重大议题是否与战略/KPI挂钩并动态调整？

Approach to Sustainability / 3.2.2. Focusing on What Matters Most

[Content]
In preparation of this Report, the Group completed a materiality assessment with the participation of the Group's major stakeholders, in collaboration with an external consulting firm. For the materiality assessment, the Group reached out to the members of the Governance Group for the ESG Report and five other stakeholder groups (employees, major shareholders and investors, customers, suppliers, and the public) via a materiality survey. The Group followed the four-stage process described below when conducting the materiality assessment.

results.section: Approach to Sustainability / 3.2.2. Focusing on What Matters Most
results.text: Materiality assessment is fundamentally significant for the Group's sustainable development. It helps us to prioritise and highlight the material ESG issues from both internal and external stakeholders. The results of the materiality assessment guide us in constructing our ESG reporting framework and provide insights into our strategic decision-making process.

results.section: Approach to Sustainability / 3.2.2. Focusing on What Matters Most
results.text: To analyse the relative materiality of each ESG issue, the Group consolidated stakeholders' views and mapped the ESG issues on a matrix in two perspectives, which are the 'Importance to the Stakeholders' and the 'Importance to the Group'. The Governance Group for the ESG Report decided that the issues that are of high importance to both our stakeholders and the Company (mapped on the upper right corner of the matrix) are the high-materiality issues of the Group.
